11-11.solution: Net rate \(= \frac{1}{8} + \frac{1}{10} - \frac{1}{5} = \frac{5 + 4 - 8}{40} = \frac{1}{40}\) of the tank an hour, positive, so it fills in \(40\) hours.

11-13.solution: In 2 hours both fill \(2\left(\frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{6}\right) = \frac{5}{6}\). A fills the last \(\frac{1}{6}\) at \(\frac{1}{4}\) an hour: \(\frac{2}{3}\) hour.

11-24.solution: Net rate \(= \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{20} = \frac{4 + 5 - 1}{20} = \frac{2}{5}\) an hour, so \(2.5\) hours, which is 2 hours 30 minutes.

11-26.solution: A and B fill \(2\left(\frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{8}\right) = \frac{7}{12}\) in 2 hours. With C open the net rate is \(\frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{8} - \frac{1}{12} = \frac{5}{24}\), so the last \(\frac{5}{12}\) takes 2 hours: \(4\) hours in all.
